prose_changes.old: Its institutional line runs on into the papal reform of the eleventh century and through that into the Latin church of the whole later Middle Ages. Corrected texts of the Bible and the Roman liturgy that stayed standard for centuries; and the cathedral and monastic schools that were the seed-bed of the medieval universities. prose_changes.new: Its church law ran on into the papal reform of the eleventh century. In 1081 Pope Gregory VII still quoted papal letters forged in the Frankish lands two centuries before.
